title: Intention (Niyyah)
description: Form the intention in your heart to perform wudu for the sake of Allah, purifying yourself before worship. The intention is not spoken aloud.

title: Say Bismillah
description: Begin by saying "In the name of Allah," as taught in the Sunnah before starting wudu.
translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

title: Wash the Hands
description: Wash both hands up to the wrists three times, making sure water reaches between the fingers.

title: Rinse the Mouth
description: Take water into the mouth and rinse it thoroughly, three times.

title: Rinse the Nose
description: Sniff water gently into the nostrils and then blow it out, three times.

title: Wash the Face
description: Wash the whole face three times, from the hairline to the chin and from ear to ear.

title: Wash the Right Arm
description: Wash the right arm from the fingertips to (and including) the elbow, three times.

title: Wash the Left Arm
description: Wash the left arm from the fingertips to (and including) the elbow, three times.

title: Wipe the Head
description: With wet hands, wipe over the head once, moving from the front to the back and then back to the front.

title: Wipe the Ears
description: Wipe the inside of the ears with the index fingers and the outside with the thumbs, once.

title: Wash the Right Foot
description: Wash the right foot up to (and including) the ankle, three times, including between the toes.

title: Wash the Left Foot
description: Wash the left foot up to (and including) the ankle, three times, including between the toes.

title: Recite After Wudu
description: After completing wudu, it is Sunnah to bear witness to the oneness of Allah and ask to be among those who purify themselves.
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ. اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
